about_the_game:
Do you find it amusing to watch staff members push long long shopping carts while you're shopping? Then welcome to my shopping mall and start working as a Shopping Cart Pusher.

About this demo version:

You can play in the area on the second floor of the shopping mall

You can collect up to 10 shopping carts

Your mission sounds simple: find all 50 shopping carts scattered around the mall and return them safely to their designated parking spots. But you'll soon discover that this will be the most frantic, hilarious, and unexpected "simulation" job you've ever had!

These shopping carts seem to have minds of their own and won't obey. The physics-based simulation makes every cart push a hilarious challenge! Control your speed and direction; if you're not careful, your cart team will be like a runaway train, crashing through merchandise displays, sliding across slippery floors, and even hurtling down ramps.

But it's more than just pushing carts. To find the hiding places of these "cunning" shopping carts, you'll need to use your wits and solve clever puzzles: activate malfunctioning elevators, push past layers of obstacles, and navigate the pitch-black warehouse.

  • Physics Simulation: Experience a unique shopping cart experience and revel in the joy of losing control and crashing into each other.

  • Explore the Megamall: From the brightly lit department store to the dark and mysterious inventory warehouse, explore a vast and detailed shopping mall and discover its hidden secrets.

  • Clever Environmental Puzzles: The mall itself is your puzzle-solving tool. Use environmental mechanics, interactable objects, and the shopping carts themselves to create new paths.

  • 50 Naughty Shopping Carts: Find and recover all 50 scattered shopping carts, each hidden in unexpected places, challenging your observation and skills.

  • Uncover Hidden Secrets: Collect secrets hidden throughout the mall, leading to completely different storylines.
